composite_identity: STPC-CORPUS-R01 over canonical JSON sorted array of {path,bytes,sha256}; each sha256 is raw file SHA-256 of exact bytes; exclude only MANIFEST.json and SHA256SUMS to avoid recursion
domain_encoding: ASCII label + NUL byte + exact payload bytes
field_order: sort object keys; preserve array order; no implicit defaults
json_canonicalization: objects lexicographic Unicode key order; compact separators; ensure_ascii=false; integer only; no floats/NaN; duplicate keys rejected
newline: one terminal LF (0x0a) required and significant for each canonical JSON file/object
purpose: corpus and evidence identity only; NOT production signing/key algorithm or trust-root activation
